name: Wi-Fi client (kitsune)
description: A kitsune fox that behaves as a station: probes for / associates with a network under a spoofed MAC, on a duty cycle. Hunters find it as a client. Configuration is compiled into the firmware from a conference header; this page prepares, checks and exports that header (docs/kitsune-integration-plan.md). kitsune belongs to its authors: https://github.com/rfhs/kitsune
